# Halvorsen

[Navy](../Navy.md)

*Game data as of 24 May 314.*

<!-- Generated by build_wiki.py. Edit the lore file, not this page. -->

The light cruiser, the Accord's missile line: sustained long-range barrages, with speed and sensors over armour, and a ship that can guard a colony on its own. Like the light cruiser line the bible asks for, it is meant to be refitted mark after mark rather than replaced. Named, like all light cruisers, for a great comet and the astronomer who found it.
